1.bug_analyze: Prism’s TypeScript grammar was treating the property name “type” (even when used as an interface key) as a reserved keyword, coloring it like the “export” and “interface” tokens. In reality, “type?” here is just an optional property name and should be highlighted the same way as other object keys (for example, “data” or “total”).
1.patch_analyze: In the patched screenshot the “type?” property is no longer styled like a keyword and instead matches the color of the other property names. That aligns with the expected behavior of treating it as a normal identifier rather than a language keyword.
